Every fix the planner claims (B1-B3, NB1-NB5) is present in both the plan markdown and the sprint JSON, and the two agree on all of them except Q3: M4.1 depends_on is [] with a stated step-1/step-2 split and merge order; AC6 is owned by M4.5 with M4.4 passing on its own sim-test gate; the S1 ordering is made executable with the m4-track-b stacked-PR mechanism; the D-19 wording, M4.5/M4.6 dependency additions and the gpt6-1-sol disclosure are in. Totals (10 milestones, 4 waves, 3,220 LOC), approved:null, all passes:null and the open questions are unchanged, and the loop resolved no ruling. Two small new defects remain: M4.5 is still described as a Track A merge-to-main PR although it now depends on Track B code that sits on m4-track-b until S1 (B-R2-1), and the markdown Q3 does not carry the stacking mechanism or the quorum note that the JSON Q3 does (B-R2-2).
